description: Graphene W90 snapshot-scaling train-only payload reusing validated MD datasets from graphene_w90_snapshot_scaling_10_500_paper_ready_like_20260608_163955 and graphene_w90_snapshot_scaling_150_1000_dense_20260609_132720. No MD/SIESTA/dataset generation is executed; only Graph2Mat/DeepH training, inference, metrics and ranking run on existing frozen-split datasets. Each method/config/N uses 4 independent training seeds.

dataset_sweep.notes: Recipes are metadata/fallback only. Actual dataset paths come from graphene_w90_snapshot_scaling_reuse_10_1000_4seeds_dataset_catalog/summary/dataset_sweep_summary.json via reuse_dataset_sweep_from_run_root. MD/SIESTA generation is never launched.

cost_accounting.siesta_wall_time_source: RUN.out timer: Elapsed wall time (sec), plus runner generation_seconds/elapsed_seconds per dataset row.

notes.intended_use: Train-only reuse benchmark for combined 10-1000 snapshot scaling with 4 seeds per config.
notes.temperature_distribution: 20% at 150 K, 60% at 300 K, 20% at 450 K for every dataset size.
notes.paper_ready_parallelism: Graph2Mat 7 parallel jobs, DeepH 5 parallel jobs, alternating model batches, starting with DeepH.
notes.scientific_policy: Only MD size varies. SIESTA physics/template, material, basis and pseudopotentials are held fixed. Test/validation split policy remains blocked_with_gap.
notes.paper_ready_similarity: Uses two fixed paper-ready anchors per model: G2M-T600-26, G2M-T1000-03, DH-T600-13 and DH-T1000-04. Hyperparameter search is disabled so dataset size remains the main variable.
notes.batch_size_guard: Graph2Mat anchors use batch_size 40 and 32; DeepH anchors use batch_size 4 and 8. Reject this payload if any generated Graph2Mat config has batch_size > 80.
notes.discretization_policy: Dense dataset-size grid from 10 to 500 snapshots, reusing requested/previous scaling sizes where possible: 10,20,25,30,40,50,55,60,70,75,80,90,95,100,120,150,180,200,220,250,280,300,500.
notes.dataset_root_policy: Uses a fresh dataset root to avoid overwriting or colliding with previous snapshot-scaling datasets that were generated with a different training payload.

duplicate_resolution_policy.rule: Union of both source runs. When N exists in both, prefer paper_ready_like for N<=500; otherwise use the only available source.
